Your attention is worth more than an ad.
If today’s tools let us make our own apps, why keep giving away our information and our attention to apps full of ads and microtransactions?
For years, having an app on your phone meant accepting a deal nobody really signed: the app is \"free\", but we pay for it with our data, our time and our patience.

At the home stove (the fogón) nobody ever cooked to sell. People cooked for the household, with whatever there was, and there was always enough for one more. Fogón does the same with software: apps cooked at home, with the help of artificial intelligence, to meet real needs. They aren’t out to make money, and they’re shared with whoever comes by.
It’s not the first time

The minga: neighbors working for free on something for everyone. Gandhi’s spinning wheel: spinning at home instead of buying. The Rochdale Pioneers: 28 workers who opened their own shop. Linux: \"just a hobby\" that now runs the internet. Wikipedia: the largest encyclopedia, without a single ad.
Ordinary people, simple tools, shared work and nobody against anybody. Today, the simple tool is artificial intelligence.
No enemies
Fogón isn’t against anyone. We don’t copy brands, we don’t attack companies, we don’t break rules. We just light the stove and show, with facts, that there’s another way.
What we promise
There’s always enough for one more.
